QuestInfo.name: [Detective Rave's Case Notes] Not the Stew!
QuestInfo.0: You met the arms dealer Plunk at the #bBlack Market#k. Would he still have the cargo?
QuestInfo.1: While Rave peeking at the ledger, Gloogers stole Plunk's goods and ran off. Track them down in #bSketchy Back-Alley 1#k.
QuestInfo.2: Rave saved a poor Glooger that was in danger. The Sketchy Hooligans ran off when they heard the goods belong to Plunk.
